title: centella affinis
intro: Centella affinis, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a type of herbaceous perennial plant in the family Apiaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and neuroprotective properties, which may help to improve cognitive function, reduce anxiety and stress, and support skin health. The therapeutic actions of Centella affinis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may interact with various cellular pathways to promote healing and reduce inflammation. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic and traditional Chinese medicine to treat a range of health conditions, including fever, skin disorders, and gastrointestinal issues.
